Project.title: Project
Project.description: Studio video narrative project containing workflow stages, script, concepts, and timeline configuration

name.description: Title or display name of the project

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the project was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated

thumb.description: Optional thumbnail image URL or base64 preview

durationSec.description: Total estimated or calculated duration in seconds

clipCount.description: Number of scenes or video clips

currentStage.description: Active workflow stage index from 1 to 7

progressPct.description: Overall workflow completion percentage from 0 to 100

status.description: Status string (Draft, Scripting, Visualizing, Ready, Exported)

archived.description: Whether the project has been archived

data.description: Comprehensive serialized narrative state, scenes, visual prompts, and timeline edit data

GlobalSettings.title: GlobalSettings
GlobalSettings.description: Production presets, default channels, and studio workspace preferences

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when settings were last saved

channels.description: List of configured YouTube studio channels and default styling

preferences.description: App user interface and rendering preferences

/projects/{projectId}.description: Collection storing shared projects and video scripts accessible across devices

/settings/{settingsId}.description: Collection storing central studio configuration, channels, and presets
